{"task":{"id":"Prob154_fsm_ps2data","spec":"
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  clk
 - input  reset
 - input  in (8 bits)
 - output out_bytes (24 bits)
 - output done

The module should implement a finite state machine that will search for
message boundaries when given an input byte stream. The algorithm we'll
use is to discard bytes until we see one with in[3]=1. We then assume
that this is byte 1 of a message, and signal the receipt of a message
once all 3 bytes have been received (done). The FSM should signal done in
the cycle immediately after the third byte of each message was
successfully received.

Implement the datapath module that will output the 24-bit (3 byte)
message whenever a packet is received (out_bytes[23:16] is the first
byte, out_bytes[15:8] is the second byte, etc.). The reset signal is
active high synchronous. out_bytes needs to be valid whenever the done
signal is asserted. You may output anything at other times (i.e.,
don't-care). Assume all sequential logic is triggered on the positive
edge of the clock.

Here is an example waveform:

Inline all helper logic inside TopModule; do not define auxiliary modules. xczu3eg-sbva484-1-e; 5 ns synthesis clock; simulator seed 1. No reference dependencies, hierarchy outside the DUT, file access, includes or DPI."},"current":{"revision_id":"879a587b-9301-401b-b69e-3ff72faa4e37","source_sha256":"a4ee6f69f7882f49c0879145f26c26457c51a8708476342bead3f43e9ab02261","source":"
module TopModule (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        reset,
    input  logic [7:0]  in,
    output logic [23:0] out_bytes,
    output logic        done
);

    typedef enum logic [1:0] {
        IDLE  = 2'd0,
        BYTE1 = 2'd1,
        BYTE2 = 2'd2,
        BYTE3 = 2'd3
    } state_t;

    state_t state;
    logic [7:0] b1, b2, b3;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state     <= IDLE;
            done      <= 1'b0;
            out_bytes <= 24'h000000;
            b1        <= 8'h00;
            b2        <= 8'h00;
            b3        <= 8'h00;
        end else begin
            done <= (state == BYTE3);

            case (state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (in[3]) begin
                        state <= BYTE1;
                        b1    <= in;
                    end
                end

                BYTE1: begin
                    state <= BYTE2;
                    b2    <= in;
                end

                BYTE2: begin
                    state <= BYTE3;
                    b3    <= in;
                end

                BYTE3: begin
                    out_bytes <= {b1, b2, b3};
                    if (in[3]) begin
                        state <= BYTE1;
                        b1    <= in;
                    end else begin
                        state <= IDLE;
                    end
                end

                default: state <= IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
